input.answer: Regular unleaded gasoline at self-service filling stations in Montréal, Quebec cost 198.4 cents per litre in September 2026 (the latest month in the table). For context, August 2026 was 184.9 cents per litre. The change is (198.4 − 184.9) / 184.9 = 13.5 / 184.9 = +7.3%. The tool returned the value with scalar factor "units" and did not return an explicit unit label, so the cents-per-litre unit is taken from the question's framing and the table's usual basis.
